sentences.text:
18.12.2015 :-
 Shri S.K. Vyas, learned Senior counsel with Shri Kamalshankar, learned counsel for the petitioner.
 Shri R.S. Parmar, learned counsel for the respondent/State.
Learned counsel for the respondent/State prays for time to file reply of I.A. No.8850/2015.

Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that private complaint has been filed against the petitioner under the provisions of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, whereas, the PFA Act has been repealed by the notification dated 04/08/2011, issued under Section 97 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.

Thus, the private complaint against the petitioner is not maintainable,
whereas, in the said complaint, Trial Court has fixed the date of appearance of the petitioner.
In such circumstances, further proceedings of the case be stayed till the next date of hearing.
On considering the prayer made on behalf of the learned Senior Counsel for the petitioner, further proceedings in the Trial Court shall remain stayed till the next date of hearing.
Let the appeal be fixed for consideration of I.A. No.8850/2015, an application for grant of stay of further proceedings on 13/01/2016.

[J.K. Jain]
